title: Formation True Principles
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji had just buried his discovery deep in his heart, unaware that Li Hao had already quietly transmitted the news—a hunt targeting the inheritor of the Tianji Record was about to begin.

text.content:
Millions of shattered mirror fragments floated in the air, each reflecting Chen Ji's terrified face. His footsteps halted, and the stride he was about to take was nailed to the spot by an oppressive force as vast as primordial chaos.

That aura was ancient, too ancient for mortal things, as if it had existed since the dawn of heaven and earth, merely a wisp of remnant consciousness roused from slumber by his disturbance.

dialogue.content:
(This aura... something's wrong!)

Chen Ji's Heavenly Eye in his brow center suddenly opened, and golden light pulsed forth, revealing traces of that formless oppression. The true nature of the illusion was laid bare in his spiritual awareness—this was no mere illusion, but a shocking grand formation that used destiny as its pattern and time as its path!

text.content:
The surrounding 'mirror surfaces' were not true mirrors, but suspended talismans. Their surfaces flowed with obscure patterns that, upon closer inspection, faintly outlined the contours of mountains, rivers, sun, moon, and stars—the trajectories of destiny.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, and his heart almost skipped a beat.

dialogue.content:
(Fate Deduction Array... this is the exclusive technique of an ancient Master of Heavenly Secrets!)

His breathing quickened, fingertips trembling slightly. Had he not witnessed it himself, he would never have believed that such a divine-level formation, existing only in the fragmented remnants of ancient texts, was hidden in the depths of this illusion!

text.content: Not far away, Han Lie sat cross-legged, circulating his energy to resist the formation's erosion. Sensing Chen Ji's unusual behavior, he opened his eyes and snorted coldly.

dialogue.content:
Waste of space! What are you staring at?

Han Lie's voice was full of mockery. This formation is bizarre. If you want to die, don't drag others down with you!

text.content: Chen Ji's lips curved slightly upward. Without refuting, he merely lowered his eyes, concealing the flash of sharp light in his gaze. He walked slowly, seemingly casually approaching the formation's core area, but in truth, every inch of movement was precisely calculated by his Heavenly Eye.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji discovered hidden key information in the formation's core area. How should he act?

choices.text: Use the Heavenly Eye for deep-level analysis
choices.description: Consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate to peer into the formation's deepest secrets using the Tianji Record's power, but this will trigger violent reactions from the formation and may expose his special nature.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete principles of the Fate Deduction Array
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye's forced analysis may disturb the sleeping entity

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his consciousness sinking into the Heavenly Eye in his brow center. Golden light burst forth from the depths of his pupils, and in an instant, all the talismans in the sky seemed to ignite, illuminating simultaneously.

dialogue.content:
(Come, let this one see what secrets you hide!)

Heavenly Fate Value flowed away like water. A flood of information surged into his Mental Sea—the formation's core structural diagram, the complete logical chain of fate deduction, and even...

choices.text: Resonate with the Tianji Record Fragment
choices.description: Without consuming Heavenly Fate Value, take out the Tianji Record Fragment and create resonance with the formation. More covert, but the information obtained may be incomplete.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain partial formation information while maintaining a low profile
choices.risk_hint: Resonance may be incomplete, missing key clues

text.content: Chen Ji quietly took out the Tianji Record Fragment from his sleeve, concealing it in his palm. The symbols on the Fragment resonated faintly with the talismans in the formation.

dialogue.content:
(Indeed... this formation's aura shares the same origin as the Tianji Record!)

His pupils contracted violently. A shocking conjecture took shape in his heart—the ancient great being who created the Tianji Record was probably the same person who set up this Fate Deduction Array!

text.content: Just then, Chen Ji's peripheral vision caught a covert movement—Li Hao at the rear of the group, taking advantage of others' inattention, quietly crushed a transmission jade talisman. A faint spiritual energy fluctuation flashed and vanished, but the Heavenly Eye captured every detail.

dialogue.content:
(An insider... how interesting.)

Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, but his heart was like a clear mirror. Li Hao's action was clearly sending a message to the outside world, and who this 'outside world' was, he did not yet know. But what could be determined was that someone had already set their sights on this exploration team.

text.content:
The moment the Heavenly Eye captured Li Hao's transmission, a blurry vision of the future emerged in his Mental Sea—in three days, numerous unidentified cultivators would surround this place. And he, Chen Ji, would become the target of everyone.

His eyelids twitched slightly as he silently cursed the trouble.

dialogue.content:
Hey, waste of space!

Han Lie's voice interrupted Chen Ji's contemplation. He frowned, looking at Chen Ji: What was that light in your brow center just now? Why did it suddenly flare with golden radiance?

text.content: Chen Ji cursed internally. When the Heavenly Eye was fully analyzing earlier, it had been too conspicuous and attracted the attention of this simple-minded fool. Yet his face showed only confusion. He raised his hand, rubbing his brow center.

choice.prompt: Han Lie questions the anomaly in Chen Ji's brow center. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Use the废物 persona as cover, claiming he was merely dazzled by the formation's light. Safe, but cannot dispel Han Lie's suspicions.
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie may not be easily convinced

text.content: Chen Ji blinked, looking at Han Lie with an innocent expression.

dialogue.content:
What is Han-shixiong talking about? This little junior has nothing unusual... Oh, you mean the brow center?

He feigned sudden realization, raising his hand to rub his forehead: The formation's light is too blinding. I was just dazzled just now. Probably spiritual energy colliding with the acupoints. It's nothing serious.

choices.description: Don't respond directly. Instead, question why Han Lie is so focused on him, turning the topic toward Han Lie's anomalies, implying Han Lie is the one with problems.
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie is put on the defensive by the counter-question

text.content: Chen Ji did not dodge, but instead met Han Lie's gaze, his lips curving slightly upward.

dialogue.content:
Han-shixiong has sharp eyes indeed. However...

He shifted topics, his smile glancing meaningfully at the storage bag at Han Lie's waist: But this junior is curious. Why did shixiong linger so long in front of that ancient stele? Did you discover something good? Why not share it with the rest of us, so we can broaden our horizons too?

text.content: Han Lie's expression changed slightly. He had indeed made a discovery in front of the ancient stele, and being called out publicly like this left him momentarily speechless. He snorted coldly and turned his face away, no longer pursuing the question, but the suspicion in his eyes grew even deeper.

Meanwhile, Chen Ji's analysis of the formation's core area was nearing completion. Countless fragments of information in his Mental Sea stitched together into a complete picture—the so-called 'illusion' was in fact a world-shocking formation capable of observing the course of destiny.

Its creator was precisely that legendary ancient Master of Heavenly Secrets.

dialogue.content:
(Tianji Record... Fate Observation Array... same origin of aura...)

Chen Ji's heart was churning like tempestuous waves. A terrifying speculation gradually took shape: the Tianji Record was perhaps originally a treasure fragment refined by this ancient Master of Heavenly Secrets for observing destiny?

text.content:
However, what alarmed him even more was that this Fate Observation Array was not intact. There was a ferocious crack in its core area, as if torn apart by some powerful force. At the crack, a trace of extremely faint yet familiar fluctuation remained—

That was the aura of the Tianji Record!

choice.prompt: Chen Ji discovered the deep connection between the formation and the Tianji Record, as well as Li Hao's betrayal. How should he decide?

choices.text: Share the discovery with the entire team
choices.description: Publicly expose Li Hao's betrayal while also sharing the formation's true principles. Wins trust but exposes his own strength, and may alert the enemy.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the entire team's trust, establish leadership position
choices.risk_hint: Li Hao's forces behind him may act desperately

text.content: Chen Ji looked around, his expression solemn.

dialogue.content:
Fellow shixiong, I carefully investigated this formation just now...

He paused, his gaze casually sweeping over Li Hao: There's a major discovery! But before sharing it, I'd like to ask Brother Li—just now, who were you sending that message to by crushing the transmission jade talisman?

choices.description: Bury all discoveries deep in his heart, study the connection between the formation and Tianji Record privately. Secretly monitor Li Hao, wait for the right moment.
choices.visible_reward: Exclusive intelligence advantage, greater room for later scheming
choices.risk_hint: Bear the risks alone, may be ambushed

text.content: Chen Ji's expression remained normal, as if he had discovered nothing. He quietly retreated to a corner of the group.

dialogue.content:
(Li Hao... very well. You like transmitting messages, don't you? Then this one will let you transmit to your heart's content.)

He lowered his eyes. A complete set of plans had already formed in his heart. The encirclement in three days? It might not necessarily be a trap set for him.

text.content: The team continued deeper into the formation's core area. Chen Ji appeared to walk carelessly at the rear, but in truth, every moment he was deducing countless possibilities for the future. Although the Heavenly Eye was restricted, at such close range, he could still capture some blurry tributaries of destiny.

He saw a blurry scene—in three days, this place would be surrounded by dozens of black-clad figures. The leader's features were obscured, but terrifying Demonic Path aura swirled around him. This was no ordinary demonic cultivator, but... an expert from the Holy Sect!

Li Hao, indeed, was a person of the Holy Sect.

dialogue.content:
(Holy Sect... it seems this one's existence has attracted the attention of certain people.)

Chen Ji's lips curled into a cold smile. He had long anticipated the Holy Sect's coveting of the Tianji Record. He just hadn't expected it to come so quickly.

text.content:
He made no move to expose anything, merely quietly putting the Tianji Record Fragment back into his sleeve. This intelligence was too important. Once leaked, it would not only expose the fact that he possessed the Tianji Record, but would also drive the Holy Sect to desperation.

Better to turn the tables and make a counterattack.

Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly; he already had a plan. The encirclement in three days? It might be a rare opportunity for him—if he could use this chance to investigate the Holy Sect's layout in this area, even grasp Li Hao's evidence for a counterattack...

In the depths of the formation, that ancient aura grew increasingly dense. Chen Ji knew this was the precursor to the formation's core opening. He took a deep breath,收敛 all emotions, and put back on the mask of a cowardly废物.

The real game had just begun.

dialogue.content:
(Three days... that's enough.)

He silently calculated the time in his heart, and the hint of a smile at the corner of his mouth vanished in an instant. The废物 Chen Ji was still that waste that anyone could step on twice.

Only no one knew what kind of world-shaking chess game was hidden behind those seemingly murky eyes.
